title: Taking Away within 10
seo_title: Taking Away within 10 – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Take away from a group and count how many are left; subtract within 10 with pictures, ten frames and a number line. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: take away within 10 with crossed-out pictures, ten frames, number lines and stories. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Cross out and count what is left
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Start with the whole group.
  • Cross out the ones that go away.
  • Count the ones that are left. 6 − 2 = 4.

Examples

Example

8 − 3 = ?

Start at 8

Count back 3: 7, 6, 5

Answer: 5

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding instead of taking awayMinus (−) means take away.
Counting the crossed-out onesCount only the ones that are left.
Counting back from the wrong placeStart counting back after 8: 7, 6, 5.
